name: Webform Views Extras
description: Extends Webform views and supports relationships in views with all content entities not only node.
project_description:
Webform Views Extras? 
 Webform Views Extras extends Webform views and supports relationships in views with all content entities not only node.

 INSTALLATION 
 composer require drupal/webform_views_extras 

 Note that this module depends on views, webform and webform_views modules.

 How to use the module? 
 After the installation, you should go to /admin/structure/webform_submission_relationships and create a new webform submission relationship, after choosing the content entity (Ex, node, user, taxonomy term, from where the Webform field was created), a new webform submission relationship will be added and accessible via views webform submissions relationships.

 NOTE:

Please don't forget to clear all caches after adding a new webform submission relationship.
